name: AI training jobs, week by week
method: A week runs Monday to Sunday, UTC. Its numbers are counted on its day of record: its Sunday, or its last day with a build when the Sunday build did not run.
A role is one listing in a platform's public feed. Copies with the same title and pay on one platform count once.

A role is new when the ledger first saw it this week on a platform we already tracked, and gone when it was open on the day of record of the week before and not on this one, with its platform's feed read on this one. A role that came back with a new id and the same title and pay is neither.

A role first seen this week that its platform dated more than 14 days before is an old posting: open, and counted apart, never as new. So is a role first seen on the day the board began to read its platform's feed in full.
A platform whose feed was not read on the day of record is marked under Platforms. Its roles are not counted as gone, and its count that day is from its last good read.
Pay is the hourly pay a listing states, a range at its midpoint, a median from 8 roles or more, nothing estimated or converted. $100+ counts the roles whose listed hourly pay reaches $100.

days_listed_median: the median number of days a role that went away this week had been listed, from its first day to its last day up to the week's day of record, over the roles first seen after the ledger's first day (Oct 1, 2026), whose start is known. It rises every week while the history is short, since nothing can yet have stayed longer than the ledger, so a page shows it only once the ledger is 13 weeks old.
notes: One row per week, platform and field: platform and field blank on the week's total row, field blank on a platform's row, platform blank on a field's row. field is the board's field, as in its address (/law).
renewed counts the new ids that are the same role as one gone (same platform, title and pay): they are neither new nor gone.
The week's own numbers (platforms_read to days_listed_n) are on its total row only.

open_sunday, open_prev_sunday, new_roles and gone_roles count every listing, paid research studies among them. A week's page states its roles with the studies set apart, and the JSON gives those numbers too: roles_sunday, roles_prev_sunday, roles_new and roles_gone are the stored counts less the research-studies field's own, and platforms_with_roles leaves out a platform whose listings are all studies. In the CSV, subtract the research-studies field's row from the week's total row.

revisions.why: its feed sent 831 roles it had not listed on Oct 13, and only 14 of them were listed again from Oct 23. The build now refuses a read like that.
